translation: Took place in posad Serock, 4 June 1890, 9 AM. Appeared personally Mendel Kupersztejn, contractor, 26, and Josek Rubinsztejn[?], blacksmith, 34, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that on 3 June at 5 PM died in posad Serock a child of female sex named Sura Bajla Berensztejn, aged three years, daughter of Chanin[?] and Chaja Brajna nee Orensztajn, the Berensztejn spouses residing in posad Serock. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
